verdict.rationale: Mangopay documents official server-side SDKs for Node.js, PHP, Python, .NET, Java and Ruby. Each has its own SDK page with install commands (composer, pip3, dotnet, Maven Central) and configuration examples, and SDK release notes are maintained (e.g. Ruby mTLS support). Front-end SDKs (Checkout, Elements, Vault, Profiler) and a published OpenAPI spec are also documented. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the SDKs work well in practice.
